    (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f (φ x)) (hφ : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 φ x) (h k : E) :
    sndFDeriv (f ∘ φ) x h k

        + fderiv ℝ f (φ x) (sndFDeriv φ x h k)

    (hr : ∀ x ∈ closedBall (0 : E) 1, HasFDerivAt r (r' x) x)
    (hr'c : ContinuousOn r' (closedBall (0 : E) 1)) {L : ℝ} (hL0 : 0 ≤ L)
    (hL : ∀ x ∈ closedBall (0 : E) 1, ‖r' x - ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E‖ ≤ L)
    (hmaps : MapsTo r (closedBall 0 1) (sphere 0 1)) (hfix : ∀ x ∈ sphere (0 : E) 1, r x = x)
    {t : ℝ} (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (htε : t < (L + 1)⁻¹) :
    ∫ x in closedBall (0 : E) 1,

name: MorseFloer.Chapter4.finrank_int_quot_add
statement:
theorem finrank_int_quot_add {ind : Crit → ℕ} {cntZ : Crit → Crit → ℤ}

      + Module.finrank ℤ (cyclesAt ind cntZ (k + 1)) = numCrit ind (k + 1)

name: MorseFloer.Chapter4.finrank_range_dLin_dual_int

theorem finrank_range_dLin_dual_int {ind ind' : Crit → ℕ} {cntZ : Crit → Crit → ℤ} {n : ℕ}

      = (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (-1 : ℤ) ^ k * (betti ind cnt k : ℤ))

name: MorseFloer.Chapter4.sum_critSet_prod
statement:
theorem sum_critSet_prod {Crit₁ Crit₂ : Type*} [Fintype Crit₁] [Fintype Crit₂]
    {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (ind₁ : Crit₁ → ℕ) (ind₂ : Crit₂ → ℕ) (m : ℕ)
    (f : Crit₁ × Crit₂ → M) :
    ∑ c : CritSet (prodIndex ind₁ ind₂) m, f c.1
      = ∑ c₁ : Crit₁, ∑ c₂ : Crit₂, if ind₁ c₁ + ind₂ c₂ = m then f (c₁, c₂) else 0

name: MorseFloer.Chapter4.sum_neg_one_pow_sub

    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (-1 : ℤ) ^ (m - k) * (x k : ℤ)
      = (-1 : ℤ) ^ m * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (-1 : ℤ) ^ k * (x k : ℤ)

name: MorseFloer.Chapter4.sum_numCrit_eq
statement:

name: MorseFloer.Chapter4.totalD_prod
statement:
theorem totalD_prod (ind₁ : Crit₁ → ℕ) (ind₂ : Crit₂ → ℕ) (cnt₁ : Crit₁ → Crit₁ → K)

theorem end_piece_estimate {A : ℝ → E →L[ℝ] E} {B : E →L[ℝ] E} {C₁ ε D T : ℝ}
    (hC₁ : 0 < C₁)
    (h124 : ∀ Z Z' : ℝ → E, (∀ s, HasDerivAt Z (Z' s) s) →
      Integrable (fun s => ‖Z s‖ ^ 2 + ‖Z' s‖ ^ 2) →
      Integrable (fun s => ‖linOp (fun _ => B) Z Z' s‖ ^ 2) →
      sobolevSq Z Z' ≤ C₁ * l2Sq (linOp (fun _ => B) Z Z'))
    (hε : 3 * C₁ * ε ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 2)
    {β β' : ℝ → ℝ} (hβd : ∀ s, HasDerivAt β (β' s) s) (hβ'c : Continuous β')
    (hβ0 : ∀ s, 0 ≤ β s) (hβ1 : ∀ s, β s ≤ 1) (hβ'le : ∀ s, |β' s| ≤ D)
    (hβ'zero : ∀ s, s ∉ Set.Icc (-T) T → β' s = 0)
    (hnear : ∀ s, β s ≠ 0 → ‖A s - B‖ ≤ ε)
    {Y Y' : ℝ → E} (hY : ∀ s, HasDerivAt Y (Y' s) s)
    (hint1 : Integrable fun s => ‖Y s‖ ^ 2 + ‖Y' s‖ ^ 2)
    (hint2 : Integrable fun s => ‖linOp A Y Y' s‖ ^ 2) :
    sobolevSq (fun s => β s • Y s) (fun s => β' s • Y s + β s • Y' s)
      ≤ 6 * C₁ * (D ^ 2 * l2SqOn Y T + l2Sq (linOp A Y Y'))

name: MorseFloer.Chapter13.exists_const_bilinear
statement:
theorem exists_const_bilinear {F' : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F'] [NormedSpace ℝ F']
    {B : P × E → (E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] F')} {B' : P × E → (E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] F')}
    (hB : Continuous B) (hB' : Continuous B')
    (hderiv : ∀ (p : P) (X : E), HasFDerivAt (fun Y => B (p, Y)) (B' (p, X)) X)
    {r₁ : ℝ} (hr₁ : 0 ≤ r₁) :
    ∃ C > 0, ∀ p : P, ∀ X ∈ closedBall (0 : E) r₁,
      (∀ v Y : E, ‖B (p, X) v Y‖ ≤ C * ‖v‖ * ‖Y‖) ∧
      (∀ v Y₁ Y₂ : E, ‖B (p, X) v Y₂ - B (p, 0) v Y₁‖
        ≤ C * (‖X‖ * ‖v‖ * ‖Y₁‖ + ‖v‖ * ‖Y₂ - Y₁‖))

name: MorseFloer.Chapter13.norm_fderiv_comp_sub_le
statement:
theorem norm_fderiv_comp_sub_le {φ : G → H} {ψ : H → K} {r₀ k₁ k₂ k₃ k₄ : ℝ}
    (hφ : Differentiable ℝ φ) (hψ : Differentiable ℝ ψ)
    (h1 : ∀ Z ∈ closedBall (0 : G) r₀, ‖fderiv ℝ φ Z - fderiv ℝ φ 0‖ ≤ k₁ * ‖Z‖)
    (h2 : ‖fderiv ℝ φ 0‖ ≤ k₂)
    (h3 : ∀ Z ∈ closedBall (0 : G) r₀,
      ‖fderiv ℝ ψ (φ Z) - fderiv ℝ ψ (φ 0)‖ ≤ k₃ * ‖φ Z - φ 0‖)
    (h4 : ‖fderiv ℝ ψ (φ 0)‖ ≤ k₄)
    (hk₁ : 0 ≤ k₁) (hk₂ : 0 ≤ k₂) (hk₃ : 0 ≤ k₃) (hk₄ : 0 ≤ k₄)
    {Z : G} (hZ : Z ∈ closedBall (0 : G) r₀) :
    ‖fderiv ℝ (ψ ∘ φ) Z - fderiv ℝ (ψ ∘ φ) 0‖
      ≤ (k₃ * (k₁ * r₀ + k₂) ^ 2 + k₄ * k₁) * ‖Z‖

name: MorseFloer.Chapter13.norm_fderiv_comp₃_sub_le
statement:
theorem norm_fderiv_comp₃_sub_le {φ : G → H} {ψ : H → H'} {χ : H' → K}
    {r₀ k₁ k₂ k₃ k₄ k₅ k₆ : ℝ}
    (hφ : Differentiable ℝ φ) (hψ : Differentiable ℝ ψ) (hχ : Differentiable ℝ χ)
    (h1 : ∀ Z ∈ closedBall (0 : G) r₀, ‖fderiv ℝ φ Z - fderiv ℝ φ 0‖ ≤ k₁ * ‖Z‖)
    (h2 : ‖fderiv ℝ φ 0‖ ≤ k₂)
    (h3 : ∀ Z ∈ closedBall (0 : G) r₀,
      ‖fderiv ℝ ψ (φ Z) - fderiv ℝ ψ (φ 0)‖ ≤ k₃ * ‖φ Z - φ 0‖)
    (h4 : ‖fderiv ℝ ψ (φ 0)‖ ≤ k₄)
    (h5 : ∀ Z ∈ closedBall (0 : G) r₀,
      ‖fderiv ℝ χ (ψ (φ Z)) - fderiv ℝ χ (ψ (φ 0))‖ ≤ k₅ * ‖ψ (φ Z) - ψ (φ 0)‖)
    (h6 : ‖fderiv ℝ χ (ψ (φ 0))‖ ≤ k₆)
    (hk₁ : 0 ≤ k₁) (hk₂ : 0 ≤ k₂) (hk₃ : 0 ≤ k₃) (hk₄ : 0 ≤ k₄)
    (hk₅ : 0 ≤ k₅) (hk₆ : 0 ≤ k₆)
    {Z : G} (hZ : Z ∈ closedBall (0 : G) r₀) :
    ‖fderiv ℝ (χ ∘ ψ ∘ φ) Z - fderiv ℝ (χ ∘ ψ ∘ φ) 0‖
      ≤ (k₅ * ((k₃ * (k₁ * r₀ + k₂) ^ 2 + k₄ * k₁) * r₀ + k₄ * k₂) ^ 2
          + k₆ * (k₃ * (k₁ * r₀ + k₂) ^ 2 + k₄ * k₁)) * ‖Z‖

name: MorseFloer.Chapter13.norm_fderiv_sub_fderiv_zero_le
statement:

theorem norm_fderiv_sub_le_of_norm_sndFDeriv_le {f : E → F} {s : Set E} {C : ℝ}

name: MorseFloer.Chapter13.norm_parDeriv_comp_sub_le
statement:
theorem norm_parDeriv_comp_sub_le {Φ : ℝ × G → H} {Ψ : ℝ × H → K}
    {ρ r₀ k₁ k₂ k₃ k₄ k₅ k₆ k₇ : ℝ}
    (hΦ : ∀ z : G, DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ (ρ, z))
    (hΨ : ∀ y : H, DifferentiableAt ℝ Ψ (ρ, y))
    (hφ : Differentiable ℝ fun w => Φ (ρ, w))
    (h1 : ∀ z ∈ closedBall (0 : G) r₀,
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun w => Φ (ρ, w)) z - fderiv ℝ (fun w => Φ (ρ, w)) 0‖ ≤ k₁ * ‖z‖)
    (h2 : ‖fderiv ℝ (fun w => Φ (ρ, w)) 0‖ ≤ k₂)
    (h3 : ∀ z ∈ closedBall (0 : G) r₀,
      ‖spaceDeriv Ψ ρ (Φ (ρ, z)) - spaceDeriv Ψ ρ (Φ (ρ, 0))‖ ≤ k₃ * ‖Φ (ρ, z) - Φ (ρ, 0)‖)
    (h4 : ‖spaceDeriv Ψ ρ (Φ (ρ, 0))‖ ≤ k₄)
    (h5 : ∀ z ∈ closedBall (0 : G) r₀, ‖parDeriv Φ ρ z - parDeriv Φ ρ 0‖ ≤ k₅ * ‖z‖)
    (h6 : ∀ z ∈ closedBall (0 : G) r₀,
      ‖parDeriv Ψ ρ (Φ (ρ, z)) - parDeriv Ψ ρ (Φ (ρ, 0))‖ ≤ k₆ * ‖Φ (ρ, z) - Φ (ρ, 0)‖)
    (h7 : ‖parDeriv Φ ρ 0‖ ≤ k₇)
    (hk₁ : 0 ≤ k₁) (hk₂ : 0 ≤ k₂) (hk₃ : 0 ≤ k₃) (hk₄ : 0 ≤ k₄)
    (hk₅ : 0 ≤ k₅) (hk₆ : 0 ≤ k₆)
    {z : G} (hz : z ∈ closedBall (0 : G) r₀) :
    ‖deriv (fun r => Ψ (r, Φ (r, z))) ρ - deriv (fun r => Ψ (r, Φ (r, 0))) ρ‖
      ≤ ((k₁ * r₀ + k₂) * (k₆ + k₃ * (k₅ * r₀ + k₇)) + k₄ * k₅) * ‖z‖

name: MorseFloer.Chapter13.norm_sndFDeriv_comp_le
statement:
theorem norm_sndFDeriv_comp_le {ψ : F → G} {φ : E → F} {x : E}

name: MorseFloer.Chapter13.sndFDeriv_comp_floer
statement:
theorem sndFDeriv_comp_floer {ψ : F → G} {φ : E → F} {x : E}
    (hψ : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 ψ (φ x)) (hφ : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 φ x) (h k : E) :

name: MorseFloer.Chapter15.exists_connecting
statement:
theorem exists_connecting {R : Type*} [Ring R] {A B C : ℕ → Type*}
    [∀ k, AddCommGroup (A k)] [∀ k, Module R (A k)]
    [∀ k, AddCommGroup (B k)] [∀ k, Module R (B k)]
    [∀ k, AddCommGroup (C k)] [∀ k, Module R (C k)]
    (i : ∀ k, A k →ₗ[R] B k) (j : ∀ k, B k →ₗ[R] C k)
    (dA : ∀ k, A (k + 1) →ₗ[R] A k) (dB : ∀ k, B (k + 1) →ₗ[R] B k)
    (dC : ∀ k, C (k + 1) →ₗ[R] C k)
    (hinj : ∀ k, Function.Injective (i k))
    (hsurj : ∀ k, Function.Surjective (j k))
    (hexact : ∀ k, LinearMap.ker (j k) = LinearMap.range (i k))
    (hi : ∀ (k : ℕ) (x : A (k + 1)), dB k (i (k + 1) x) = i k (dA k x))
    (hj : ∀ (k : ℕ) (x : B (k + 1)), dC k (j (k + 1) x) = j k (dB k x))
    (hBB : ∀ (k : ℕ) (x : B (k + 2)), dB k (dB (k + 1) x) = 0)
    (k : ℕ) (c : C (k + 2)) (hc : dC (k + 1) c = 0) :
    ∃ (b : B (k + 2)) (a : A (k + 1)),
      j (k + 2) b = c ∧ i (k + 1) a = dB (k + 1) b ∧ dA k a = 0

    ∃ (U : Set (Matrix m m ℂ)) (P : Matrix m m ℂ → Matrix m m ℂ), U ∈ 𝓝 A₀ ∧
      ContinuousOn P U ∧ ∀ A ∈ U,
        P A * P A = P A ∧ A * P A = P A * A ∧
        aeval A (fPoly c r A) * P A = 0 ∧ aeval A (gPoly c r A) * (1 - P A) = 0 ∧
        (∀ x, aeval A (fPoly c r A) *ᵥ x = 0 → P A *ᵥ x = x) ∧
        (∀ x, aeval A (gPoly c r A) *ᵥ x = 0 → P A *ᵥ x = 0) ∧

theorem proj_spec {u v f g : ℂ[X]} (hfg : aeval A (f * g) = 0)
    (hR : IsUnit (aeval A (u * f + v * g)).det) :
    aeval A (v * g) * (aeval A (u * f + v * g))⁻¹ * (aeval A (v * g) * (aeval A (u * f + v * g))⁻¹)
        = aeval A (v * g) * (aeval A (u * f + v * g))⁻¹ ∧
      A * (aeval A (v * g) * (aeval A (u * f + v * g))⁻¹)
        = aeval A (v * g) * (aeval A (u * f + v * g))⁻¹ * A ∧
      aeval A f * (aeval A (v * g) * (aeval A (u * f + v * g))⁻¹) = 0 ∧
      aeval A g * (1 - aeval A (v * g) * (aeval A (u * f + v * g))⁻¹) = 0 ∧
      (∀ x, aeval A f *ᵥ x = 0 → (aeval A (v * g) * (aeval A (u * f + v * g))⁻¹) *ᵥ x = x) ∧
      (∀ x, aeval A g *ᵥ x = 0 → (aeval A (v * g) * (aeval A (u * f + v * g))⁻¹) *ᵥ x = 0)

theorem exists_eigen_family {G : (m → ℂ) → (m → ℂ) → ℂ} (hG : IsHermForm G)
    {V : Submodule ℂ (m → ℂ)} {k : ℕ} {b : Fin k → (m → ℂ)} (hb : LinearIndependent ℂ b)
    (hspan : Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range b) = V) :
    ∃ (f : Fin k → (m → ℂ)) (d : Fin k → ℝ), LinearIndependent ℂ f ∧
      Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range f) = V ∧
      (∀ c : Fin k → ℂ, (G (∑ j, c j • f j) (∑ j, c j • f j)).re = ∑ j, ‖c j‖ ^ 2 * d j) ∧
      (gram G b).charpoly.roots = Finset.univ.val.map (RCLike.ofReal ∘ d) ∧

statement:
theorem rot_conjTranspose (u v : ι → ℂ) :
    (rot u v)ᴴ = 1 + vecMulVec u (star v - star u) -
      (1 + herm u v)⁻¹ • vecMulVec (v - herm u v • u) (star u + star v)

statement:

    (rot u v)ᴴ *ᵥ y = y + (herm v y - herm u y) • u -
      ((1 + herm u v)⁻¹ * (herm u y + herm v y)) • (v - herm u v • u)

name: MorseFloer.UnitaryLoops.rot_mulVec

theorem rot_mulVec (u v x : ι → ℂ) :
    rot u v *ᵥ x = x + herm u x • (v - u) -
      ((1 + herm v u)⁻¹ * (herm v x - herm v u * herm u x)) • (u + v)
